intro: The Lattice bed gives you deep sleep and deeper storage. With its clean panels and colour-block tone, it helps you stay organised — while turning your bed into the boldest thing in the room.

features.title: Engineered strength that holds it all together
features.text: Our sturdy engineered wood frame gives you lasting support without compromising on aesthetics — made to handle everyday living, beautifully.

features.title: Storage that rises with your needs
features.text: With a smooth hydraulic lift-up base, accessing your underbed storage feels effortless — more room, less effort, no bending or heavy lifting. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Headboard comfort you can count on
features.text: Soft yet supportive, the cushioned headboard invites you to sit back, relax, and make the most of your downtime — from reading to just doing nothing.

features.title: A finish that feels natural, looks timeless
features.text: The textured matte wood finish brings in a warm, grounded feel — adding subtle sophistication and tactile charm to your space.

features.title: Storage where style meets function
features.text: Thoughtful headboard compartments and a handy ledge keep your night-time essentials within reach — because life’s little comforts should always be close by.

name: Upmods Lattice King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
